'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Michael Pistone DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Commencement
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
